prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.2%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Personality & Style Customizer Screen: Redesign pick_friend screen into a grid layout with live mascot preview and interactive personality trait selector cards. (why: Adoption step suffers from low conversion (60.9%) and long decision time (89s median), indicating friction when choosing pets.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In After Adoption Certificate Step: Move sign-in screen to take place after adoption certificate creation and immediately prior to waiting. (why: Sign-in experiences dropoff (72.9%) before users feel attached to their custom pet; moving it after pet selection builds motivation.)
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop Placement & Diagnostic Verification Flow: Incorporate a live desktop overlay diagnostic check on the waiting screen to test rendering and window positioning. (why: Multiple support emails reported pets failing to appear on desktop or screen initialization stalling.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo Generation Guidance & Quality Hint: Add photo selection guidelines and sample photo quality tips to the photo upload step. (why: Support received complaints about custom pets failing to generate or returning distorted visual results.)
4: [finish, layout] Two-Column Launch Readiness Screen Layout: Restructure home_intro into a two-column layout separating companion introduction from main desktop launch actions. (why: Finish step dropoff is 35.2% and median duration is 395s; clear layout separation reduces orientation lag.)
5: [choose_path, notification] Fast-Track Quick Path Selection Prompt: Display a prominent fast-track recommendation banner on story screen highlighting quick pet selection. (why: choose_path mean duration is 514s, indicating initial user hesitation when starting onboarding.)

Deferring sign-in builds motivation before requiring account creation.
Strong evidence from support complaints, but requires building a diagnostic flow.
High evidence from support tickets and cheap to add via guidance copy/hints.
